missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Среда' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'изменилась'. 'Городская' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Среду' is the accusative direct object of 'беречь'. The feminine ending -а shifts to -у in the accusative. 'Природную' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Среды' takes the genitive to link the protection to its object. 'Окружающей' agrees in the feminine genitive in the standard phrase for the environment.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Среде' takes the dative after 'к', showing adaptation toward the environment. The feminine dative singular ends in -е. 'Новой' agrees.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Средой' takes the instrumental because 'управлять' governs that case. The feminine instrumental singular ends in -ой. 'Рабочей' agrees.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Среде' takes the prepositional after 'в' to show the setting. The feminine prepositional singular ends in -е. 'Этой' agrees.

missions.phrase: Я встречаюсь с друзьями в среду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of time. 'Среду' uses the accusative in the time phrase 'в среду', meaning on Wednesday, the homonym sense. The feminine accusative ends in -у.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Среды' is the nominative plural subject of 'требуют', referring to different environments. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Средах' takes the prepositional plural after 'в' to show the various habitats. The plural ends in -ах. 'Разных' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Среды' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The feminine genitive singular ends in -ы. 'Здоровой' agrees.
